explication: ClawGod patches the official Claude Code runtime and launches the patched CLI rather than providing a replacement client. The main workflow is: the user launches Claude Code, the ClawGod wrapper loads provider settings and runtime controls, then starts the patched bundle; optional OpenAI-compatible configuration routes API traffic through a translation proxy. The patcher, native-binary extraction, and re-patching support version updates. README capabilities such as feature unlocks, restriction removals, reliability fixes, and Lean Settings are represented at subsystem level. Some update and patcher connections rely on README statements because their source was not fully sampled.
